tasks.title: Setup Company Management System
tasks.description: Implement multi-tenant company management with data isolation, company creation, and user invitation system
tasks.details: Create companies table with proper schema, implement Row Level Security (RLS) policies for data isolation, build company registration flow for first user, create admin interface for company management, implement user invitation system with email verification, ensure all subsequent features respect company-level data scoping. Use Supabase RLS policies to automatically filter all queries by company_id.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for company CRUD operations, integration tests for RLS policies, test user invitation flow, verify complete data isolation between companies, test company admin permissions

tasks.title: Implement User Authentication and Role Management
tasks.description: Build secure authentication system with Supabase Auth and implement role-based access control (Admin, Manager, User)
tasks.details: Configure Supabase Auth with email/password authentication, implement password reset functionality, create user registration flow that requires company association, build user profile management with avatar upload to Supabase storage, implement RBAC with three roles (Admin, Manager, User), create RLS policies for role-based data access, build role assignment interface for admins, implement session management and logout functionality.
tasks.testStrategy: Authentication flow tests, password reset tests, role permission tests, RLS policy tests, session persistence tests, profile update tests

tasks.title: Create Project Management System
tasks.description: Build project creation, listing, and management functionality with company-scoped data access
tasks.details: Create projects table with company_id foreign key, implement project CRUD operations with real-time updates, build project creation form with name, description, and status fields, create project listing page with search and filtering, implement project status management (active, archived, completed), add project assignment to users, ensure all project operations respect company boundaries and user roles, implement optimistic updates for better UX.
tasks.testStrategy: Project CRUD tests, real-time update tests, role-based access tests, search and filter tests, company isolation tests

tasks.title: Implement Ticket Management System
tasks.description: Build comprehensive ticket system with workflow management, assignment, and status tracking
tasks.details: Create tickets table with project_id foreign key, implement ticket CRUD operations, build ticket creation form with title, description, priority, and assignment fields, implement status workflow (new → in_progress → review → done), create ticket listing with filtering by status, priority, and assignee, add ticket search functionality with full-text search, implement ticket comments system, build ticket history tracking, ensure real-time updates across all ticket operations.
tasks.testStrategy: Ticket CRUD tests, workflow validation tests, assignment tests, search functionality tests, real-time update tests, comment system tests

tasks.title: Build Time Tracking System
tasks.description: Create timer functionality with time entry management for accurate time tracking on tickets
tasks.details: Create time_entries table with ticket_id and user_id foreign keys, implement start/stop timer functionality using Zustand for state management, build real-time timer display with elapsed time updates, ensure only one active timer per user, implement automatic time entry creation on timer stop, build time entry management interface for viewing, editing, and deleting entries, add duration calculations and formatting, implement browser storage for timer persistence across page refreshes.
tasks.testStrategy: Timer functionality tests, time entry CRUD tests, duration calculation tests, browser persistence tests, single active timer enforcement tests

tasks.title: Create Dashboard and Analytics
tasks.description: Integrate real data into existing dashboard layout - connect stats cards, weekly summary, and recent activity feed to actual database data
tasks.details: The dashboard layout and basic components already exist but currently show placeholder/hardcoded data. Need to integrate real data by connecting stats cards to actual project/ticket/time tracking data from database, implement weekly summary calculations with real time tracking data, build recent activity feed with actual user activities (project updates, ticket changes, time entries), ensure efficient data aggregation for dashboard performance, implement real-time updates for live metrics, and maintain the existing responsive design.
tasks.testStrategy: Data integration tests, metric calculation accuracy tests, activity feed functionality tests, dashboard performance with real data tests, real-time update tests

subtasks.title: Connect stats cards to real database data
subtasks.description: Replace hardcoded 0 values in dashboard stats cards with actual data from projects, tickets, and time tracking tables

subtasks.title: Implement weekly summary data integration
subtasks.description: Connect weekly summary component to real time tracking data and calculate actual weekly totals, trends, and progress

subtasks.title: Build recent activity feed with real data
subtasks.description: Replace placeholder recent activity feed with actual user activities from database - track project updates, ticket changes, time entries, and other user actions

subtasks.title: Implement real-time dashboard updates
subtasks.description: Add real-time update functionality to refresh dashboard metrics and activity feed as data changes without requiring page refresh

subtasks.title: Optimize dashboard data loading performance
subtasks.description: Implement efficient data aggregation and caching to ensure dashboard loads quickly with real data and maintains sub-2 second load times

tasks.title: Implement Search and Navigation System
tasks.description: Build global search functionality combining existing entity searches and add intuitive navigation with breadcrumbs and quick access
tasks.details: Current state: Individual search exists for projects (name/description), tickets (title/description), and users (name/email). Need to implement unified global search interface that combines all entity searches with result ranking, add search history functionality, create responsive navigation using Next.js App Router, implement breadcrumb navigation for all pages, add quick access to recent items, implement advanced filtering combinations across entities, ensure search responds within 500ms, implement keyboard navigation support, create mobile-responsive navigation menu with proper accessibility.
tasks.testStrategy: Global search integration tests, individual entity search validation, advanced filtering tests, search performance tests, navigation tests, breadcrumb tests, mobile responsiveness tests, keyboard navigation tests, accessibility tests

subtasks.title: Create Global Search Interface Component
subtasks.description: Build unified search interface that combines existing project, ticket, and user searches
subtasks.details: Create a global search component that can search across all entities simultaneously, display results grouped by type (projects, tickets, users), implement result ranking algorithm, add search suggestions and autocomplete

subtasks.title: Implement Advanced Filtering System
subtasks.description: Add advanced filtering combinations across different entity types
subtasks.details: Create filter interface for combining searches (e.g., projects by user + status, tickets by project + priority), implement filter persistence, add filter presets for common combinations

subtasks.title: Add Search History and Recent Items
subtasks.description: Implement search history tracking and quick access to recent items
subtasks.details: Store search history in local storage, provide recent searches dropdown, implement recent projects/tickets quick access, add clear history functionality

subtasks.title: Build Breadcrumb Navigation System
subtasks.description: Implement breadcrumb navigation for all pages using Next.js App Router
subtasks.details: Create breadcrumb component that automatically generates navigation paths, integrate with Next.js routing, ensure proper hierarchy display for nested pages

subtasks.title: Create Mobile-Responsive Navigation Menu
subtasks.description: Build responsive navigation with keyboard support and accessibility
subtasks.details: Implement mobile hamburger menu, add keyboard navigation support, ensure ARIA compliance, test with screen readers, optimize touch targets for mobile

tasks.title: Build Billing Periods Management
tasks.description: Create billing period system for organizing time entries into weekly, bi-monthly, and monthly periods
tasks.details: Create billing_periods table with company_id foreign key, implement billing period CRUD operations for admins, build period creation interface with frequency selection (weekly, bi-monthly, monthly), implement automatic time entry association with active billing periods, add period status management (draft, active, closed), create period overlap validation, build billing period listing and management interface, ensure efficient querying for large time entry datasets.
tasks.testStrategy: Billing period CRUD tests, overlap validation tests, time entry association tests, admin permission tests, performance tests with large datasets

tasks.title: Implement Billing Rates and Calculations
tasks.description: Create flexible billing rate system with company defaults, user overrides, and project-specific rates
tasks.details: Create billing_rates and company_billing_settings tables, implement rate hierarchy system (Project > User > Company Default), build rate management interface for admins, implement historical rate tracking with effective dates, create billing calculations for time entries, add currency support (MVP: USD), build time_entry_billing association table, implement automatic billing amount calculations, ensure rate changes don't affect historical calculations.
tasks.testStrategy: Rate hierarchy tests, historical rate tests, billing calculation tests, currency handling tests, rate override tests

tasks.title: Create Time Reports and Export System
tasks.description: Build comprehensive reporting system with multiple export formats for billing and analysis
tasks.details: Build time report generation interface with filtering by period, user, project, and date range, implement efficient aggregation queries for large datasets, create PDF export with company branding using a PDF generation library, implement CSV and Excel export with proper formatting, build report caching system for performance, create billing dashboard with current period overview, add detailed time entry descriptions in reports, implement different aggregation levels (daily, weekly, monthly), ensure reports load within 5 seconds for up to 1000 entries.
tasks.testStrategy: Report generation tests, export format tests, performance tests with large datasets, filtering tests, caching tests, billing dashboard tests

tasks.title: Implement Missing Core Collaboration Features
tasks.description: Implement ticket comments system UI, file upload attachments for tickets and projects, and notification system for user assignments and mentions to complete core collaboration functionality.
tasks.details: Build ticket comments UI components since database schema exists - create comment creation form with rich text editor, comment listing with user avatars and timestamps, comment editing and deletion capabilities, and real-time comment updates. Implement file upload system using Supabase storage for both tickets and projects - create drag-and-drop upload interface, file preview functionality, attachment listing with download links, file type validation, and size limits. Build comprehensive notification system - create notifications table with user_id, type, and metadata fields, implement real-time notifications for ticket assignments and @mentions in comments, build notification center UI with mark as read functionality, add email notifications for critical events, implement notification preferences, and ensure proper RLS policies for notification access.
tasks.testStrategy: Comment system tests including CRUD operations, real-time updates, and permissions. File upload tests covering drag-drop functionality, storage integration, file validation, and download capabilities. Notification system tests including real-time delivery, email notifications, mention detection, assignment notifications, and notification preferences. Integration tests ensuring comments, attachments, and notifications work together seamlessly across tickets and projects.

tasks.title: Implement User Profile Management Features
tasks.description: Build comprehensive user profile management including profile editing, password reset functionality, and user preferences system to enhance user experience and account security.
tasks.details: Implement user profile management by creating profile editing interface allowing users to update name, email, and profile information with proper validation. Build secure password reset functionality using Supabase Auth reset password flow with email verification and password strength requirements. Create user preferences system with settings for notifications, theme preferences, timezone, and language options. Add profile picture upload using Supabase storage with image resize and validation. Implement account security features like password change, two-factor authentication setup, and session management. Build user settings dashboard with tabbed interface for profile, security, and preferences. Ensure all profile operations respect company boundaries and user roles. Add audit logging for profile changes and security events. Implement proper form validation using React Hook Form and Zod schemas. Create responsive mobile-friendly interface for all profile management features.
tasks.testStrategy: Profile editing tests including form validation, field updates, and error handling. Password reset flow tests covering email sending, token validation, and password update. User preferences tests for all settings categories with persistence validation. Profile picture upload tests including file validation, storage integration, and image processing. Security feature tests for password changes, 2FA setup, and session management. Cross-browser compatibility tests for profile interface. Integration tests with Supabase Auth and storage. Accessibility tests for all profile management forms.

tasks.title: Implement Time Entry Management CRUD Operations
tasks.description: Build comprehensive time entry management system with editing, deletion, and dashboard functionality to complete the CRUD operations for time tracking.
tasks.details: Implement time entry editing functionality by creating edit forms with validation for time, date, description, and project fields, ensuring proper authorization checks and optimistic updates. Build time entry deletion with confirmation modal to prevent accidental deletions, implementing soft delete with audit trail preservation. Create time tracking dashboard with current week/month overview, recent entries display, total hours summary, and quick entry creation. Add time entry search and filtering capabilities by date range, project, and description. Implement time entry duplication feature for recurring tasks. Ensure all operations maintain billing period associations and update billing calculations automatically. Add bulk operations for multiple entry management. Implement time entry templates for common tasks to improve user efficiency.
tasks.testStrategy: Time entry editing tests including form validation, field updates, authorization checks, and optimistic UI updates. Deletion tests with confirmation flow, soft delete verification, and audit trail preservation. Dashboard tests covering data aggregation, date range filtering, and real-time updates. Search and filter functionality tests with various criteria combinations. Bulk operations tests for multiple entry management. Template system tests for creation and usage. Performance tests with large datasets and concurrent user operations.

tasks.title: Enhanced Time Reports with Export Functionality
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive time reporting system with daily, weekly, and monthly reports, plus CSV and PDF export capabilities for both time tracking and billing data.
tasks.details: Build enhanced time reporting system by creating daily, weekly, and monthly time report views with improved filtering and aggregation capabilities beyond basic reports. Implement CSV export functionality for time entries with customizable column selection, date range filtering, and proper formatting for external analysis tools. Create PDF export system for professional client reports with company branding, summary statistics, and detailed breakdowns. Build billing export functionality with PDF invoices containing time entry details, rate calculations, and totals, plus CSV export for accounting systems integration. Enhance existing time reports with better date range selectors, project/user filtering, and visual improvements. Implement export job queue system for large datasets to prevent timeout issues. Add export history tracking and download management interface. Ensure all exports respect company data isolation and user permissions. Create export templates that can be customized per company for branding consistency.
tasks.testStrategy: Test daily, weekly, and monthly report generation with various date ranges and filters. Validate CSV export formatting and data accuracy across different scenarios. Test PDF generation with proper styling, branding, and content layout. Verify billing export calculations match time entry data and rates. Test export functionality with large datasets and verify performance. Validate permission-based export access and company data isolation. Test export download and history management features. Perform cross-browser compatibility tests for export functionality.

tasks.title: Implement Company Settings Management and System Configuration
tasks.description: Build comprehensive company settings management with application configuration, system administration features, and enhanced UI states including theme support and loading/error handling.
tasks.details: Implement company settings page (0.4) allowing administrators to manage company profile, billing information, user permissions, and organizational preferences with proper validation and authorization checks. Build application settings page (8.1) for system-wide configuration including email templates, notification preferences, integration settings, and feature toggles with role-based access control. Create system configuration interface (8.3) for technical settings like database maintenance, backup schedules, security policies, and performance monitoring accessible only to system administrators. Implement dark/light theme support (UI.3) using next-themes with proper CSS variables, component theming, and user preference persistence across sessions. Add comprehensive loading states (UI.4) with skeleton loaders, progress indicators, and spinners for all async operations. Implement robust error state handling (UI.5) with user-friendly error messages, retry mechanisms, fallback UI, and proper error logging. Ensure all settings are properly validated, cached for performance, and respect company-level data isolation through RLS policies. Create responsive design that works across all device sizes with proper accessibility support.
tasks.testStrategy: Test company settings CRUD operations with proper authorization checks and data validation. Verify application settings persistence and role-based access restrictions. Test system configuration changes with proper admin-only access controls. Validate theme switching functionality across all components and pages with proper persistence. Test loading states for all async operations including network delays and slow connections. Verify error handling with network failures, validation errors, and server errors including proper user feedback and recovery options. Test responsive design across different screen sizes and accessibility compliance with screen readers and keyboard navigation.

tasks.title: Implement Missing Database Tables and API Endpoints for Attachments and Notifications
tasks.description: Create attachments and notifications database tables with their corresponding API endpoints, plus file upload and notification management endpoints to support collaboration features.
tasks.details: Create attachments table with fields for file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, uploaded_by, ticket_id, project_id, and timestamps to support file attachments on both tickets and projects. Implement notifications table with fields for user_id, type, title, message, read_status, related_entity_type, related_entity_id, and timestamps to support user notifications for assignments and mentions. Build API endpoints for attachments including POST /api/attachments for file uploads with multipart/form-data support, GET /api/attachments for listing attachments by ticket/project, DELETE /api/attachments/:id for file deletion with proper authorization. Create notification API endpoints including GET /api/notifications for user notifications with pagination, PUT /api/notifications/:id/read for marking as read, POST /api/notifications for creating notifications (internal use), and DELETE /api/notifications/:id for notification cleanup. Implement file upload handling with Supabase Storage integration, file type validation (documents, images), size limits (10MB max), and proper error handling. Add notification creation triggers for ticket assignments, mentions in comments, and project updates. Ensure proper RLS policies for both tables to respect company-level data isolation and user permissions.
tasks.testStrategy: Test attachments table creation and constraints, verify file upload API with various file types and sizes, test attachment listing and deletion with proper authorization. Test notifications table schema and RLS policies, verify notification creation for different trigger events, test notification API endpoints including pagination and read status updates. Validate file storage integration with Supabase, test file type and size validation, verify proper cleanup of orphaned files. Test notification delivery for assignments and mentions, validate real-time notification updates, ensure notifications respect user permissions and company isolation.
